title: Trinity plutonium fallout plume over Roswell
place_text: Trinity site and Roswell, New Mexico

tellings.quote: plume full of plutonium uh that didn't get burned up in the explosion, it just was still there passed over Roswell, so there had a big strip of of uh ur- uranium uh plutonium contaminated soil around Roswell

plain: When the first atomic bomb was tested at the Trinity site in New Mexico in 1945, a plume carrying plutonium that "didn't get burned up in the explosion" is said to have drifted over Roswell and left "a big strip" of contaminated soil around the town. The physicist John Brandenburg tells Michels this as something he was told. He brings it up because it would give a reason for something to take an interest in Roswell two years later.
